title: Family Phone Plan Upgrade
scenario: A text offers a cheaper family plan if you enter all member details.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.C: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: Family Phone Plan Upgrade: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Phone plans should be changed through the carrier account.
